items: 【2026 Latest Android 15 & Google Certified】 MoonStars 11-inch Android Tablet runs the latest 2026 GMS Android 15 operating system.Powered by a high-speed MTK8786 octa-core processor, this tablet ensures exceptionally smooth and responsive operation for all your tasks, alongside robust privacy and data management controls. Enjoy seamless access to your favorite HD streaming platforms like Netflix, Hulu, and Prime Video.Built-in built-in parental controls help create a safe digital environment for children, making it the perfect, versatile tablet for the whole family.

【Vibrant 11-inch Full HD IPS Display】This Android 15 tablet Immerse yourself in a stunning visual experience with the 11-inch In-Cell IPS display, featuring a sharp 1280x800 Full HD resolution. This advanced screen technology produces exceptionally refined, true-to-life colors and superior visual clarity. The sleek narrow-bezel design maximizes the screen area for a wider, more engaging viewing angle. The Android tablet also offers Reading Mode, Eye Protection Mode, and Dark Mode intelligently to minimize eye strain, ensuring comfortable viewing during extended use, whether you're working or enjoying entertainment.

【16GB+128GB+1TB Expandable Large-Capacity Tablets】This 11-inch Android 15 tablet features 16GB of memory (8GB physical + 8GB virtual) and 128GB of internal storage, expandable up to 1TB via microSD card (card not included). Allow you to store endless e-books, songs, photos, videos, and games without worry. This expansive capacity ensures a consistently smooth and lag-free experience, even with extensive data.

【DUAL 4G LTE+Dual 5G&2.4G WIFI+Bluetooth 5.0】The tablet supports dual SIM cards (SIM cards not included) for Dual 4G LTE standby (Supports T-Mobile), keeping you productive and connected online. It is also equipped with high-speed AC 2.4G/5G dual-band Wi-Fi and advanced Bluetooth 5.0, ensuring more stable wireless signals, faster data transmission speeds, and swift, reliable connections for all your devices.

【Long-Lasting 7000mAh Battery for All-Day Use】This 11-inch tablet powered by a high-capacity 7000mAh battery, this tablet provides up to 7-8 hours of continuous use on a single charge (actual usage may vary). Recharging is quick and convenient via the modern Type-C port. This reliable battery life makes it the perfect companion for extended activities like commuting, traveling, reading, watching movies, binge-watching your favorite shows, or listening to music.

【Dual Cameras & Immersive Dual Speakers】This Android 15 tablet build-in a clear 8MP front cam and a 13MP rear camera, whether for video calls or photos, you can effortlessly take clear and detailed images. The high-quality dual speakers complement the visual experience by delivering immersive, balanced sound, creating a truly engaging audiovisual journey for various scenarios like watching videos or gaming.

【2 in 1 Tablets with Keyboard& Accessories】The 5G Wi-Fi tablet includes a Bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse, stylus, and a foldable protective case, effortlessly transforming your 11-inch tablet into a productive laptop-style device. Leverage features like split-screen multitasking, GPS, and enhanced privacy protection for efficient work, study, or entertainment on the go. It's the ultimate all-in-one solution to meet your productivity and creativity needs anywhere, anytime.
